properties.name: spring.sql.init.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether initialization should continue when an error occurs.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.data-locations
properties.description: Locations of the data (DML) scripts to apply to the database.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.encoding
properties.description: Encoding of the schema and data scripts.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.mode
properties.description: Mode to apply when determining whether initialization should be performed.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.password
properties.description: Password of the database to use when applying initialization scripts (if different).

properties.name: spring.sql.init.platform
properties.description: Platform to use in the default schema or data script locations, schema-${platform}.sql and data-${platform}.sql.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.schema-locations
properties.description: Locations of the schema (DDL) scripts to apply to the database.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.separator
properties.description: Statement separator in the schema and data scripts.

properties.name: spring.sql.init.username
properties.description: Username of the database to use when applying initialization scripts (if different).

properties.name: spring.sql.init.enabled
properties.description: Whether basic script-based initialization of an SQL database is enabled.
